title: 有馬記念の後に・友を繋ぎし誠は信

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki may have lost, but she can still feel how much she's improved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd is abuzz about the battle between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross, and Oguri Cap is dubbed the star of the generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No one says Yaeno Muteki's name. No one mentions the clash that took place at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rage burns within Yaeno Muteki. She cries that she and the others who battled for the Classic Triple Crown are the real stars of the generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She swears to defeat Oguri Cap and prove that she and her friends are the ones leading this generation. She now has the piece that she has been missing—an obsession.
